turnResponse.formula: heading eases toward target: d/dt = error * 1

notes: deltaMult is 1 per frame unless low-fps mode (dt*80): the reference is frame-coupled at 80 fps.
Speed only increases with Forward and decreases with Backward; there is no reverse (min 0).
Heading eases toward a target that the rudder moves, so turns start and stop softly.
Safe height = max(terrain + 2500, sea level when both here and 8192u ahead are over water).
Deck carry: the player offset is re-measured in ship-local axes every frame, so you can walk the deck in flight.
Rest/wait: game-time jumps over 5 s are integrated in 4096u steps against the same safe-height rule.

linearAccel.note: Applies to forward, side and vertical alike; no speed cap in practice.

drag.note: Released axes decay geometrically; this is the reference for coasting.

notes: Momentum on every axis, including strafe and yaw, with drag when released: the "excellent flight" feel.
Hull collision: paired inner/outer marker objects, one castRay per pair; any hit sends ShipHit.
Deck detection: a 1000u downward ray from the player picks the object stood on.

boatZ.formula: boat origin held at z 0 (sea level)

notes: The PLAYER moves (ModWaterWalking 1) and the boat is SetPos-ed under them every frame.
Boat heading = player heading: mouse-look steers.
Exit when the player Z rises above 0 (walked onto land), or by activating the boat.
stopsound footWaterLeft/Right every frame: walking on water otherwise splashes.
Wind direction re-targets on weather change and drifts up to 30 deg per game hour (SC_WindAngleScript).
Sail polar: BestPoint / ClosestPoint (deg off the wind) per ship; inside ClosestPoint the ship decelerates at 2x Decel.
MaxSpeed = BaseSpeed + windSpeed * WindBonusMult * sailingSkill * polar(angle); capped at SpeedLimit * hull/durability.
Rowboat: WindBonusMult 0, BestPoint 180, ClosestPoint 0 -- oars only.

speedLimit.note: cap with full wind, scaled by hull damage

waterOffset.formula: boat setPos z while sailing (sea level 0)

;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Begin KS_SR_Boat_Script

;SCRIPT DEPENDENCIES
;KS_SR_Boat_Create
;KS_SR_Boat_Create_Detect
;KS_SR_Boat_Create_Detect_R
;KS_SR_Boat_Multiplier
;KS_SR_Boat_Multiplier_02
;KS_SR_Boat_Multiplier_03
;KS_SR_Boat_FTravel_GM
;KS_SR_Boat_FTravel_SN
;KS_SR_Boat_FTravel_TB
;KS_SR_Boat_FTravel_SM
;KS_SR_Boat_FTravel_DF
;KS_SR_Boat_FTravel_KH
;KS_SR_Boat_FTravel_Ship

;ITEM DEPENDENCIES
;activator KS_SR_Boat (script attaches to)
;misc KS_SR_misc_ship_repair
;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
;GLOBAL PARMATERS
;===============================================================================
;float KS_SR_Boat_Angle		; store object Angle before it gets deleted
;short SC_Boat_AutoTurn		; 0=manual turning, 1=auto turn
;short KS_SR_Boat_Cellchange	; flag when player change cell
;short KS_SR_Boat_Damage	; Boat hull rating
;float KS_SR_Boat_Distance	;
;short KS_SR_Boat_Exist		;
;short KS_SR_Boat_Gear		;
;short KS_SR_Boat_Hitflag	;
;short KS_SR_Boat_Sailmode	; 0=dismounted, 1=sailing
;short KS_SR_Boat_Speed		; Sailing speed
;float KS_SR_Boat_X		; Boat x coord
;float KS_SR_Boat_Xdistance		;
;float KS_SR_Boat_Xmul		; pre-determined sin/cos multiplier
;float KS_SR_Boat_Y		; Boat y coord
;float KS_SR_Boat_Ymul		; pre-determined sin/cos multiplier
;float KS_SR_Boat_Ydistance		;
;float KS_SR_Ship_Angle		; Ship Angle
;short KS_SR_Ship_Exist		; Ship exist and boat docking state
;float KS_SR_Ship_X		; Ship x coord
;float KS_SR_Ship_Y		; Ship y coord
;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
;LOCAL PARAMETERS
;===============================================================================
float xx				; object x coordinates
float yy				; object y coordinates
float zz				; object z coordinates
float oangle			; object z axis angle
float zangle			; player z axis angle
float xxx				; player x coordinates
float yyy				; player y coordinates
float zzz				; player z coordinates
float xxxx			; boat x coordinate when land on shore
float yyyy			; boat y coordinate when land on shore
short landed		; parameter set when player landed
float stimer			; timer used to delay delete object
short sscript		; parameter set when cell change
short doOnce		; parameter used to set boat position once immediately after creation
short select			; button used for selecting options
short selectflag1	; flag set when boat is activated
short selectflag2	; flag set when FTS or Fast Travel is selected
short delay			; parameter used to delay Disable/Enable
float temp			; temporary parameter
short flag
short pressed		; flag to chk SNEAK button pressed and released
float xdist			; parameter used to calculate x distance
float ydist			; parameter used to calculate y distance
float distance		; parameter used to calculate avg distance
short startflag		; parameter used to chk whether boat is docking
short disableflag	; flag used to disable ship script
short repair			; parameter used to calculate repair pts

float ShipMaxHP
float maxspeed
float turnrate
float Repairmod
float Repairamount 

;optional Timer To improve High FPS Control
float timer
if ( SRE_ShipScriptTimer == 1 )
	If ( timer <= SRE_ShipScriptTime )
		set timer to ( timer + getsecondspassed )
		Return
	Endif
Endif
set timer to 0

Set ShipmaxHP to KS_SR_Boat_Durability
set maxspeed to KS_SR_Boat_SpeedLimit * ( KS_SR_Boat_Damage / KS_SR_Boat_Durability ) * SRE_Shipspeedmult
set turnrate to KS_SR_Boat_Turnrate * SRE_ShipTurnMult
set Repairmod to KS_SR_Boat_Repairmod
set Repairamount to KS_SR_Boat_RepairAmount

if ( maxspeed < SRE_ShipMinSpeedLimit )
	set maxspeed to SRE_ShipMinSpeedLimit
endif




float PlayerSailposoffsetx
float PlayerSailposoffsety
float PlayerSailposoffsetz

;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; SCRIPT BEGINS
;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( MenuMode == 1 )
	return
endif

if ( SRE_CustomSailpos == 0 )
	set PlayerSailposoffsetx to SC_AselShip_SailingPosx
	set PlayerSailposoffsety to SC_AselShip_SailingPosy
	set PlayerSailposoffsetz to SC_AselShip_SailingPosz
else
	set PlayerSailposoffsetx to SC_Custom_SailingPosx
	set PlayerSailposoffsety to SC_Custom_SailingPosy
	set PlayerSailposoffsetz to SC_Custom_SailingPosz
endif


;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Delete object
;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if ( disableflag == 1 )
	Disable
	if ( CellChanged == 1 )
		SetDelete, 1
	endif
	return
endif

if ( SRE_OpenMW == 0 )
if ( KS_SR_Boat_Speedf > 0 )
	if ( CellChanged == 1 )
		set KS_SR_Boat_Cellchange to 1
	endif
endif
endif

if ( SC_AutoselectedBoat == 1 )
if ( SC_AselShip_Exist == 4 )
	Disable
	SetDelete, 1
	set SC_StoreBoat to 4
	startscript SC_BoatStorage
	return
endif
endif

if ( SC_AutoselectedBoat == 1 )
if ( SC_AselShip_Exist == 2 ) ;activateShip and storeboat
	set KS_SR_Boat_Speedf to 0
	set KS_SR_Boat_Sailmode to 0
	Stopscript SC_Ship_Multiplier
	set SC_StoreBoat to 2
	startscript SC_BoatStorage
endif
endif


if ( SC_AselShip_Exist >= 2 )
	if ( SC_AselShip_Exist != 10 )
		return
	endif
endif


;Disable and Delete When Selling Ships
if ( KS_SR_Boat_exist == 0 )
	disable
	set sscript to 2
endif

;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Object will warp or remain in previous cell during cell change. To replace the object, 
; a new object is created. Requires global script "KS_SR_Boat_Create" to create new object.
;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( KS_SR_Boat_Sailmode == 1 )
	if ( KS_SR_Boat_Cellchange == 1 )
		startscript, "SC_Ship_Create"
		set KS_SR_Boat_Cellchange to 2
		set stimer to 0
		if ( sscript > 0 )
			SetDelete,  1
			return
		endif
		set sscript to 1
	endif
endif

if ( sscript == 1 )
	if ( KS_SR_Boat_Cellchange == 0 )
		Disable
		set sscript to 2
	endif
endif

if ( sscript == 2 )
	set stimer to ( stimer + GetSecondsPassed )
	if ( stimer >= 1.5 )
		SetDelete, 1
		return
	else
		return
	endif
endif

if ( KS_SR_Boat_Speedf	 > 0 )
	if ( delay == 0 )
		Disable
		set delay to 1
	endif
endif

;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Set boat initial coordinates
;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( doOnce == 0 )
	Disable
	if ( KS_SR_Boat_X != 0 )
		if ( KS_SR_Boat_Y != 0 )
			set xx to KS_SR_Boat_X
			set yy to KS_SR_Boat_Y
			if ( KS_SR_Boat_Angle >= 0 )
				set oangle to ( KS_SR_Boat_Angle - 180 )
			else
				set oangle to ( 180 + KS_SR_Boat_Angle	 )
			endif
			setpos, x, xx
			setpos, y, yy
			setpos, z, 2
			setAngle, z, oangle
		endif
	endif
	Enable
	set doOnce to 1
endif

;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Set coordinates correct boat coordinates immediately after load game
;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( KS_SR_Boat_Sailmode == 0 )
	set xx to KS_SR_Boat_X
	set yy to KS_SR_Boat_Y
	if ( KS_SR_Boat_Angle >= 0 )
		set oangle to ( KS_SR_Boat_Angle - 180 )
	else
		set oangle to ( 180 + KS_SR_Boat_Angle )
	endif
	setpos, x, xx
	setpos, y, yy
	setpos, z, 2
	setAngle, z, oangle
endif

;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Select Menu Routine
;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


if ( selectflag1 == 1 )
	set select to GetButtonPressed
	if ( select == 0 )
		stopscript SC_Ship_Multiplier
		startscript KS_SR_Boat_Multiplier_03
		set KS_SR_Boat_Sailmode to 0
		messagebox "FAST TRAVEL", "Back to Ship", "CANCEL"
		set selectflag2 to 1
		set selectflag1 to 0
	elseif ( select == 1 )
		startscript SC_Create_Detect_R
		messagebox "Boat is slowly reversing....."
		set KS_SR_Boat_Speedf	 to -1
		set selectflag1 to 0
	elseif ( select == 2 )
		messagebox "Boat has stopped and safely anchored........"
		set KS_SR_Boat_Speedf	 to 0
		set landed to 2
		set selectflag1 to 0
	elseif ( select == 3 )
		if ( KS_SR_Boat_Damage == ShipMaxHP + Repairmod )
			Messagebox "Boat is not damaged!"
		elseif ( player->GetItemCount, "KS_SR_misc_ship_repair" > 0 )
			playsound "Repair"
			player->removeitem "KS_SR_misc_ship_repair", 1
			set repair to Repairamount
			set KS_SR_Boat_Damage to ( KS_SR_Boat_Damage + repair )
			if ( KS_SR_Boat_Damage > ShipMaxHP + Repairmod )
				set KS_SR_Boat_Damage to ShipMaxHP + Repairmod
			endif
			messagebox "Boat Health = %.0f / %.0f", KS_SR_Boat_Damage, ( ShipMaxHP + Repairmod )
		else
			messagebox "You do not have any tools to repair the boat........"
		endif
		set selectflag1 to 0
	elseif ( select == 4 )
		if ( SC_Boat_AutoTurn == 0 )
			set SC_Boat_AutoTurn to 1
			messagebox "Auto Turn"
		elseif ( SC_Boat_AutoTurn == 1 )
			set SC_Boat_AutoTurn to 0
			messagebox "Manual Turn"
		endif
		set selectflag1 to 0
		set KS_SR_Boat_Speedf to temp
	elseif ( select == 5 )
		set selectflag1 to 0
		set KS_SR_Boat_Speedf to temp
	endif
	return
endif

;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; FAST TRAVEL ROUTINE
;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( selectflag2 == 1 )
	set select to GetButtonPressed
	if ( select == 0 )
		if ( SC_AselShip_Exist == 0 )
			messagebox "You do not have a ship!!!!!!"
			set selectflag2 to 0
			set KS_SR_Boat_Speedf to temp
			set KS_SR_Boat_Sailmode to 1
		else
			fadeto 100, 0.001
			set KS_SR_Boat_X to ( KS_SR_Ship_X + ( 450 * KS_SR_Boat_Xmul	 ) )
			set KS_SR_Boat_Y to ( KS_SR_Ship_Y + ( 450 * KS_SR_Boat_Ymul	 ) )
			set KS_SR_Boat_Angle to KS_SR_Ship_Angle
			startscript KS_SR_Boat_FTravel_Ship
			set selectflag2 to 2
			set disableflag to 1
		endif

	elseif ( select == 1 )
		set KS_SR_Boat_Speedf to temp
		set selectflag2 to 0
		set KS_SR_Boat_Sailmode to 1
	endif
	if ( select >= 0 )
		startscript SC_Ship_Multiplier
	endif
	return
endif

if ( SC_AutoselectedShip == 1 )
if ( selectedFT == 1000 )
	set disableflag to 1
	;set selectedFT to 0
endif
endif


;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Activate sailing
;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( OnActivate == 1 )

	if ( KS_SR_Boat_Sailmode == 0 )
		StopScript "TribunalMain"
		DisablePlayerJumping
		DisableTeleporting
		DisableLevitation
		set xx to getPos, x
		set yy to getPos, y
		player->setPos, x, xx
		player->setPos, y, yy
		player->setPos, z, 0
		player->AddSpell "KS_SR_floatboat"		; this spell ( ability ) keeps player fm falling down
		set KS_SR_Boat_Speedf	 to 0
		set KS_SR_Boat_Sailmode to 1
		messagebox "Make sure you are on RUNNING mode!!"

		if ( SC_AselShip_Exist == 10 )
			set SC_StoreBoat to 10
			startscript SC_BoatStorage
		endif

		set SC_AutoSelectedBoat to 1 ;Rowboat
		set SC_AutoSelectedShip to 1 ;Rowboat
		startscript SC_Ship_Multiplier
		startscript KS_SR_Boat_Create_Detect

	elseif ( KS_SR_Boat_Sailmode == 1 )
		messagebox "SAIL MODE"
	endif
endif

;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Gather object and player coordinates
;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( KS_SR_Boat_Sailmode > 0 )
	set xx to getPos, x
	set yy to getPos, y
	if ( xx != KS_SR_Boat_X )
		set xx to KS_SR_Boat_X
	endif
	if ( yy != KS_SR_Boat_Y )
		set yy to KS_SR_Boat_Y
	endif
	set xxx to "player"->getPos, x
	set yyy to "player"->getPos, y
	set zzz to "player"->getPos, z
endif

;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Collision Detection Check
;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( KS_SR_Boat_Sailmode == 1 )
	set KS_SR_Boat_Xdistance to ( xxx - xx )
	set KS_SR_Boat_Ydistance to ( yyy - yy )
	set xdist to ( KS_SR_Boat_Xdistance * KS_SR_Boat_Xdistance )
	set ydist to ( KS_SR_Boat_Ydistance * KS_SR_Boat_Ydistance )
	set distance to ( xdist + ydist )
	set KS_SR_Boat_Distance to GetSquareRoot, distance
endif

if ( KS_SR_Boat_Speedf > 0 )
	if ( GetPCRunning == 0 )
		if ( KS_SR_Boat_Distance > 30 )
			set KS_SR_Boat_Hitflag to 3
			set flag to 1
			playsound "Pack"
			messagebox "Watch out!!! You SMASHED your boat into something HARD...."
		endif
		;messagebox "%.2f", distance
	endif
endif

if ( SC_AutoSelectedShip == 1 )
if ( SC_AselShip_Hitflag == 3 )
	if ( KS_SR_Boat_Speedf	 > 0 )
		set KS_SR_Boat_Damage to ( KS_SR_Boat_Damage - KS_SR_Boat_Speedf )
		messagebox "Damage = %.0f, Boat Health = %.0f / %.0f ", KS_SR_Boat_Speedf	, KS_SR_Boat_Damage, ( ShipMaxHP + Repairmod )
	endif
	if ( KS_SR_Boat_Damage <= 0 )
		Disable
		messagebox "Your boat is WRECKED!!"
		set KS_SR_Boat_Speedf	 to 0
		set SC_AselShip_Hitflag to 0
		playsound, "KS_SR_Boat_Wreck"
		set KS_SR_Boat_Exist to 0
		EnablePlayerJumping
		EnableTeleporting
		EnableLevitation
		set KS_SR_Boat_Sailmode to 0
		player->RemoveSpell "KS_SR_floatboat"
		StartScript "TribunalMain"
		SetDelete, 1
		return
	endif
	if ( flag == 0 )
		if ( KS_SR_Boat_Speedf	 > 0 )
			set xxxx to ( xx - ( KS_SR_Boat_Xmul * 40 ) )
			set yyyy to ( yy - ( KS_SR_Boat_Ymul * 40 ) )
		else
			set xxxx to ( xx + ( KS_SR_Boat_Xmul * 10 ) )
			set yyyy to ( yy + ( KS_SR_Boat_Ymul * 10 ) )
		endif
	else
		set xxxx to ( xx - ( KS_SR_Boat_Xmul * 200 ) )
		set yyyy to ( yy - ( KS_SR_Boat_Ymul * 200 ) )
	endif
	set xx to xxxx
	set yy to yyyy
	set KS_SR_Boat_Speedf	 to 0
	set SC_AselShip_Hitflag to 0
	set flag to 0
endif
endif


;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Restore all parameters after landing
;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

;SC_Menu_ShipMenus Merged ShipMenus
if ( SC_landed == 2 )
	;set SC_landed to 0
	set landed to 2
endif

if ( landed > 0 )
	set KS_SR_Boat_Speedf to 0
	Stopscript SC_Ship_Multiplier
	Disable
	set landed to 0
	set KS_SR_Boat_X to getPos, x
	set KS_SR_Boat_Y to getPos, y
	EnablePlayerJumping
	EnableTeleporting
	EnableLevitation
	player->RemoveSpell "KS_SR_floatboat"
	setPos, z, 2
	Enable
	set KS_SR_Boat_Sailmode to 0
	StartScript "TribunalMain"
	return
endif

;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Speed Control
;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( KS_SR_Boat_Sailmode == 1 )
	if ( GetPCRunning == 1 )
		if ( ScriptRunning, "KS_SR_Boat_Multiplier_02" == 0 )
			startscript "KS_SR_Boat_Multiplier_02"
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( KS_SR_Boat_Sailmode == 1 )
	if ( GetPCRunning == 1 )
		if ( KS_SR_Boat_Gear == 1 )		
			if ( KS_SR_Boat_Speedf < MaxSpeed )	; max speed can be adjusted here ( default = 10 )
				set KS_SR_Boat_Speedf to ( KS_SR_Boat_Speedf + 0.1 )
				if ( KS_SR_Boat_Speedf >= MaxSpeed * ( KS_SR_Boat_Damage / ShipMaxHP ) )
					set KS_SR_Boat_Speedf to MaxSpeed * ( KS_SR_Boat_Damage / ShipMaxHP )
				endif
				messagebox "Boat Speed : %.1f", KS_SR_Boat_Speedf	
			else
				messagebox "Boat Speed : %.1f ( max. )", KS_SR_Boat_Speedf	
			endif
		elseif ( KS_SR_Boat_Gear == 2 )
			if ( SC_Boat_AutoTurn == 0 )
				if ( KS_SR_Boat_Speedf	 != 0 )
					rotate, z, -Turnrate
					set oangle to getAngle, z
					if ( oangle >= 0 )
						set KS_SR_Boat_Angle to ( oangle - 180 )
					else
						set KS_SR_Boat_Angle to ( 180 + oangle )
					endif
				endif
			endif
		elseif ( KS_SR_Boat_Gear == 3 )
			if ( SC_Boat_AutoTurn == 0 )
				if ( KS_SR_Boat_Speedf	 != 0 )
					rotate, z, Turnrate
					set oangle to getAngle, z
					if ( oangle >= 0 )
						set KS_SR_Boat_Angle to ( oangle - 180 )
					else
						set KS_SR_Boat_Angle to ( 180 + oangle )
					endif
				endif
			endif
		elseif ( KS_SR_Boat_Gear == 4 )
			if ( KS_SR_Boat_Speedf	 > 0 ) ; min speed can be adjusted here ( default = 0 )
				set KS_SR_Boat_Speedf to ( KS_SR_Boat_Speedf - 0.1 )
				messagebox "Boat Speed : %.0f", KS_SR_Boat_Speedf	
			else
				set KS_SR_Boat_Speedf	 to 0
				messagebox "Boat Speed : 0 ( Stopped )"
			endif
		endif
	else
		stopscript "KS_SR_Boat_Multiplier_02"
	endif
endif

if ( KS_SR_Boat_Sailmode == 1 )
	if ( pressed == 0 )
		if ( GetPCSneaking == 1 )
			set pressed to 1
		endif
	else
		if ( GetPCSneaking == 0 )
			set pressed to 0
			;messagebox "SELECT OPTIONS" "Fast Travel" "Reverse" "Anchor" "Repair Boat" "Auto/Manual Turn" "CANCEL"			
			Enable
			;set selectflag1 to 1
			set SC_SRE_Shipmenu to 101
			startscript SC_Menu_ShipMenus
			;set temp to KS_SR_Boat_Speedf	
			;set KS_SR_Boat_Speedf	 to 0
			return
		endif
	endif
endif


if ( KS_SR_Boat_Gear == 4 )
	if ( KS_SR_Boat_speedf < 0 )
		set KS_SR_Boat_speedf to 0
		messagebox "Ship Speed : %.1f", KS_SR_Boat_Speedf
	endif
endif



;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
